Name: Sebastian Dark Hair and Eyes Seasonal Nyapu
Author: Engi3Piece
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]A very quick  Content Patcher mod to give Sebastian darker hair and eyes that goes with the [/size]Seasonal[size=3] Nyapu Portraits done by AhCuteArt [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Just download the mod and unzip it into the mods folder made it with Content Patcher so no need to replace it every time your mods need updating! [/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url] - Nyapu
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255?tab=description]SEASONAL SDV OUTFIT NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES[/url] - AhCuteArt
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] - Poltergeister

[size=4][b]Shout out to the GOATS[/b][/size]
[size=4]- Nyapu for the best portraits of all time![/size]
[size=4]- Oceannist for making the darker hair and eyes portrait if you want dark hair but want to keep the light lavender eyes please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20862?tab=description]check their mod out![/url][/size]
[size=4]- AhCute Art for their Seasonal Version. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt]Please check her out![/url] She has so many portraits for other mods! [/size]
[size=4]- amillionand1fandoms for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47343]Darker Demetrius Seasonal Version[/url], thought about doing one for Sebastian after seeing them port the one from Oceannist over to Content Patcher [/size]
[size=4]- and last shoutout to fireredlily on the Stardew Valley Discord had an small issue with the coding they helped me solved.[/size]

[size=4][i]Note: This was a really quick edit I am by no means a pixel artist and work might be shoddy at best. If you notice any pixels that are off please let me know and Ill see if I can fix it[/i] [/size]
